# devtooltui

Everyday developer utilities in a single binary: a keyboard-driven TUI and a
CLI that composes with pipes. Install it and read the shortcuts in the
[README](https://github.com/Judamaro/devtooltui-golang#readme).

## Tools (29)

### Formatters

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [JSON](tools/json-format.md) | Indent, minify and sort the keys of JSON |
| [XML](tools/xml-format.md) | Indent or minify XML, keeping comments and CDATA |
| [SQL](tools/sql-format.md) | Format SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CTEs and DDL |

### Encoders

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Base64](tools/base64.md) | Encode and decode standard or URL-safe Base64 |
| [URL](tools/url.md) | Encode, decode and break down URLs (percent-encoding) |
| [JWT](tools/jwt.md) | Decode JWTs and verify signatures (HMAC, RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA) |
| [HTML entities](tools/html.md) | Escape and unescape HTML entities |
| [GZip](tools/gzip.md) | Compress text to Base64 GZip and decompress it back |
| [String escape](tools/escape.md) | Escape and unescape string literals for JSON, Go, C#, SQL and shell |
| [QR code](tools/qr.md) | Draw a QR code in the terminal; save it as PNG (Ctrl+S, --out) |
| [X.509 certificate](tools/x509.md) | Decode X.509 certificates: subject, SAN, validity, key and fingerprints |

### Converters

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Timestamp](tools/timestamp.md) | Convert Unix timestamps ↔ dates (ISO 8601, RFC 1123) |
| [Number bases](tools/number-base.md) | Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal |
| [JSON ↔ YAML](tools/json-yaml.md) | Convert between JSON and YAML keeping key order |
| [Color](tools/color.md) | Convert colours between HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV, with a swatch and WCAG contrast |
| [Cron](tools/cron.md) | Explain a cron expression and list its next runs |
| [CSV ↔ JSON](tools/csv-json.md) | Convert CSV to a JSON array and back |
| [JSON → classes](tools/json-class.md) | Generate Go structs or C# records/classes from a JSON sample |
